channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Watch · Western El Paso County, Eastern/Central El Paso County, Northern Hudspeth Highlands/Hueco Mountains, Salt Basin, Southern Hudspeth Highlands, Rio Grande Valley of Eastern El Paso/Western Hudspeth Counties and 1 more
item.description: Flood Watch issued October 23 at 9:58PM MDT until October 25 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM. In effect until Oct 25, 7:00 AM CT. Areas: Western El Paso County, Eastern/Central El Paso County, Northern Hudspeth Highlands/Hueco Mountains, Salt Basin, Southern Hudspeth Highlands, Rio Grande Valley of Eastern El Paso/Western Hudspeth Counties, Rio Grande Valley of Eastern Hudspeth County. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
